name: Booster T2
summary: T2 is Booster's flagship development humanoid, about 1.4 m tall with 31 body DoF. It comes in Education and Professional versions; the Professional version uses NVIDIA Jetson Thor. It is aimed at research teams working on locomotion, manipulation and learning.

dof.original: 31 (6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head)

speed_mps.original: Max walking speed: 2 meters per second

hands: Standard, gripper and dexterous-hand versions are offered.
sensors: Binocular head camera, binocular waist camera, microphone array; optional wrist cameras and LiDAR.
compute: Education: ARM processor, 375 TOPS. Professional: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000, 2070 TFLOPS.

price.configuration: From EUR 22,500 excl. VAT (EUR 27,060 incl. VAT), Generation Robots

highlights: 48 V, 10 Ah battery with magnetic charging.
Generation Robots quotes delivery within 4 to 6 weeks.
caveats: Booster's product page states 3 m/s walking speed while press and resellers state 2 m/s.
Few independent reports of T2 field use exist yet.

sources.title: Booster T2: A humanoid robot with powerful onboard Nvidia compute
